name: PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT MSIG Life Insurance Indonesia Tbk provides life insurance products in Indonesia. The company operates through six segments: Term Insurance, Endowment, Whole Life Insurance, and Health Insurance. It offers personal accident, medical, and medika ultimax; protection and unit link life insurance; and life insurance, such as smart life guard, smile berkat, income protection x-tra, bank sinarmas, bank bukopin, smile dana sejahtera, and smile pro infinite insurance products. The company also provides group insurance; education and pension insurance; and Sharia Insurance, as well as bancassurance products. It serves individual and group customers.
